fields.text: Create a five-second product-motion concept from an object and one camera move. Default: a chrome motorcycle helmet under a single hard rim light. GLM Flash structures the brief; Omni Flash 1.1 renders 5s at 360p / 16:9 (video step $0.195, plus text). No upload required. Inspect stable object shape and coherent motion. The generated object is a concept, not an exact real product.

One unbranded chrome motorcycle helmet with a dark visor, resting on a charcoal stone plinth. Single hard rim light from camera-right, deep shadow on the left, dark studio void. No branding, extra props or text.

fields.options:
camera makes a slow quarter-orbit; the helmet stays still as hard rim light rakes across the chrome shell
locked camera; the helmet rotates slowly clockwise, specular highlights sliding around the visor
slow camera push-in; the helmet stays still until the visor fills the frame
fields.selected: camera makes a slow quarter-orbit; the helmet stays still as hard rim light rakes across the chrome shell

fields.system: Write one text-to-video prompt from the object brief and selected move. Preserve the object, material, color, setting and number of objects. Specify one continuous five-second shot with exactly the selected object and camera motion. Keep object geometry consistent; stable exposure and realistic contact shadows. Do not introduce weather, people, text, extra objects, cuts or additional camera moves. Output prompt only, 60-100 words.
